bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
branch="fix/video-chat-two-topic-pinned-doorways-20261123"
sha="09801bdbe50a5be88e43380143ff65c0385cf13b"
git fetch --no-tags origin "$branch"
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha"
wt="$PWD/.worktrees/video-two-topic-entry-20261123"
if test -d "$wt"; then test "$(git -C "$wt" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha"; else mkdir -p "$(dirname "$wt")"; git worktree add --detach "$wt" "$sha"; fi
stage="$PWD/deploy/state/video-two-topic-20261123"
mkdir -p "$stage"
docker build --target build -f "$wt/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-video-entry-builder:20261123 "$wt" >/dev/null
cid="$(docker create gace-video-entry-builder:20261123)"
trap 'docker rm -f "$cid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
docker cp "$cid:/src/artifacts/bot/dist/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs" "$stage/repair-two-video-topics.mjs"
docker exec -i deploy-gaybbs-1 node --check --input-type=module - < "$stage/repair-two-video-topics.mjs"
docker exec -i deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs --input-type=module - < "$stage/repair-two-video-topics.mjs"
echo VIDEO_TWO_TOPIC_DRY_RUN_PASS
